messages.subject: lavaan:::sam warning
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to use  lavaan:::sam (using sam.method="global") to explore the relationships between 6 latent factors as IV and 7 latent factors as DV with a small sample of 130, but I get the warning: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite (which I got also using sem function before finding out about sam, which I thought it would be a solution). When looking at matrix, there are no Haywood cases. Also, when I fit separate cfa models for each factor or cfa models only fitting separately the IV and DV everything runs ok. 
I should add that some of the latent factors have 2 indicators (with equality constraints) and some indicators for the latent IV have around 20% of missing data.

Do you have any idea of what could be the problem? 

Thank you in advance!
LM
